issue_27.title: [FORMAL E2E][Authority] New task cannot initialize GUI ledger: fixed path collides with immutable prior-task ledger
issue_27.summary: The formal E2E run was refused at PROJECT_CONTRACT_DRIFT before any ledger initialization was attempted, so this issue was NOT triggered live in this round. It is recorded as a source-static design blocker discovered by reading the reviewed source at PR #24 head 6a81326c8920e313191ea77e4ad930c79e2bd52c (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py 769 lines, src/line_backup_batch/store.py 907 lines, line numbers with zero offset).
source_facts: src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:419-423 and :501-505 hard-code the expected grant gui_ledger path to PROJECT_DIR + '/private/gui-ledger.json' (PROJECT_DIR = harness-development/line-two-album-pilot-20261014) and refuse any grant that points at a different ledger path; cli.py:410 additionally pins artifact_dir to PROJECT_DIR + '/private'.

src/line_backup_batch/store.py:492-505 initialize_project_ledger() requires the target ledger path and its gui-ledger-initialization.json receipt to be completely unused, otherwise it raises PROJECT_LEDGER_ALREADY_EXISTS (store.py:500) or PROJECT_LEDGER_ALREADY_INITIALIZED.

src/line_backup_batch/store.py:429-454 _ledger_open() requires the receipt and the ledger to agree on task_id, owner, profile, cap and ledger_path, so a new task id cannot adopt the previous task's ledger.

src/line_backup_batch/store.py:368-373 Store.ledger_path() accepts any grant ledger path that starts with harness-development/ and ends with gui-ledger.json, checking only prefix, suffix and traversal.

Consequence: keeping the existing path is refused by the ledger-initialization layer, and moving to a new task id with a new ledger path is refused by the Authorizer's hard-coded grant binding. A new formal task therefore cannot initialize any ledger under the current authority design.
